senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="K00259">same</cite>. Perf. <cite ref="K00669"><he>כָּל</he></cite>; part. <cite ref="K00015"><he>כָּאֵיל</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00521"><he>כָּיֵיל</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 3:15">Targ. Ruth. III, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 27:8">Targ. Is. XXVII, 8</cite>.—
<cite ref="Menachot 53b:15">Men. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>כי קא כייל וכ׳</he> when he measures, he measures by &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71b:7">Ab. Zar. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>אק כ׳ ודמי וכ׳</he> he measures and pours (the wine) into &c.
Ḥull. 12ᵃ, a. e. לכי תֵיכוּל עלה כורא דמילחא (I will tell you,) if you will measure out for it a kor of salt (a jesting remark).
Kidd. 79ᵇ כולי עלמא כַּיְילֵי ליה וכ׳ to all the world (wisdom) has been measured in a small kab, and to this scholar in a large kab, i.e. he wants to be wiser than all the world.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 16:18">Targ. Y. Ex. XVI, 18</cite>, v. supra.

senses.gloss: (denom. of כְּלָלָא) to generalize; lay down a rule.
to be measured. Targ. Y. II, Gen. l. c.
